scope.implemented: Exact semantic postflight readback and offline preview-to-provider evidence gate

mainlineCompatibility.existingAuthorityReadback: export.anki@1.4.1 anki-export-readback.v1 already contains ordinal, sourceCardId, Front, Back, deck, noteId, cardId and semantic hashes
mainlineCompatibility.onlyAdditive150Capability: A separate provider-read-only semantic-readback operation that re-queries current Anki state after export without re-exporting
mainlineCompatibility.actualPolicy: Use existing matched authority for the confirmed export; use its emitted readback plus the independent offline gate. Promote 1.5.0 only if the runner explicitly requires a later provider re-query.

postflightRequest.unknownExternalStateBinding: When IDs were lost, omit noteId/ankiCardId and resolve by stable global RQC_ID; never retry export automatically

semanticAssertions: exact bound noteId and ankiCardId when supplied
SHA-bound preview, confirmation command, worker request/result, artifact and readback

failureSemantics.missingOrDriftedProviderState: failed with sideEffects=[]; no reconcile and no second export
failureSemantics.missingBootstrapTaskManifest: failed/FILE_MISSING with sideEffects=[] before AnkiClient construction
failureSemantics.originalExportUnknownExternalState: run semantic-readback first; only a new explicit reconcile export may converge
failureSemantics.metricsStatement: postflight externalMutation=false and mutatingActionsObserved=[] apply only to the postflight; priorScenarioWritesInferred=false

preservedFailedFixture.cause: Runner froze expectedDeck before applying the isolated deck route
preservedFailedFixture.fix: Apply destination config before freezing semantic expectations

actualRule: Execute the confirmed export once, then one semantic-readback using returned IDs; on any mismatch publish the failure and perform no additional export
